- **Auto AFK** – Prevents being kicked for inactivity

- **Auto Jump** – Adjustable JumpPower (50-200)

- **Lock Position** – Freezes character in place
- **Walk on Water** – Enables walking on water surfaces
- **Change Time** – Toggle between Night, Day, and Midnight
- **Rejoin** – Instantly rejoin the same server
- **NaN Size** – Sets character size to NaN (invisible/glitched)
- **Reset Size** – Resets character size back to normal
- **Freeze Water** – Creates invisible platforms over water
- **Strength OP (250ms / 150ms)** – Fast auto-rep farming with adjustable speed (2000–5000 reps per cycle)
- **Auto Eat Egg (30 min / 60 min)** – Automatically consumes Protein Eggs
- **Auto Spin Wheel** – Automatically spins the Fortune Wheel
- **Hide Frames** – Hides UI frames for cleaner screen
- **Anti Lag** – Optimizes game performance (disables particles, shadows, effects)
- **Full Optimization** – Maximizes FPS by removing unnecessary visuals
- **Equip 8 Swift Samurai** – Automatically equips 8 Swift Samurai pets
- **Auto Tool** – Automatically equips and uses selected tool (Weight, Pushups, Handstands, Situps)
- **Auto Punch** – Automatically punches with the Punch tool
- **Fast Tools** – Sets all tool cooldowns to 0 for instant use
- **Auto Ground Slam** – Spams Ground Slam ability continuously
- **Auto Stomp** – Automatically uses Stomp ability
- **Auto Rock** – Automatically punches selected rock (Tiny, Golden, Frozen, Mythical, Muscle King, Jungle)
- **TP Jungle Bar + Auto E** – Teleports to Jungle Bar and automatically presses E
- **TP Jungle Squat + Auto E** – Teleports to Jungle Squat and automatically presses E
- **Fast Rebirth** – Automates rebirth process using Swift Samurai (farm) and Tribal Overlord (rebirth)
- **Auto Rebirth (Target)** – Rebirths until reaching a target rebirth count
- **Auto Rebirth (Infinite)** – Continuously rebirths without stopping
- **Auto Size 2** – Continuously sets character size to 2
- **Auto NaN Size** – Continuously sets character size to NaN
- **Auto Teleport King** – Continuously teleports to Muscle King position
- **Spam Packs (Wild Wizard + Mighty Monster)** – Automatically switches between damage and health packs
- **Auto Kill All** – Kills all non-whitelisted players
- **Whitelist / Blacklist** – Add/remove players from kill protection
- **Auto Whitelist Friends** – Automatically whitelists all friends in the server
- **Auto Good Karma** – Hits players with more evil karma than good karma
- **Auto Evil Karma** – Hits players with more good karma than evil karma
- **Anti Knockback** – Prevents being knocked back by attacks
- **Block Eating Eggs** – Prevents others from eating protein eggs
- **Kill Aura** – Kills all players within a configurable radius (1-150)
- **Show Kill Aura Ring** – Visual ring showing Kill Aura range
- **Show Player Health Bars** – Displays health bars above player heads with formatted HP (K, M, B, T, Qa, Qi)
- **Kill Target** – Kills a specific selected player
- **Spectate Player** – Spectates any player
- **Remove Punch Animation** – Removes punch animations for faster combat
- **Recover Punch Animation** – Restores punch animations
- **Auto Equip Punch** – Automatically equips Punch tool
